content: 1. Nizatidine and Atazanavir: Nizatidine reduces the plasma concentration and efficacy of atazanavir by increasing gastric pH, which decreases atazanavir solubility. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable in treatment-naïve patients, atazanavir should be taken simultaneously with nizatidine or at least 10 hours afterward. For treatment-experienced patients, refer to specific dosage adjustment recommendations. 2. Nizatidine and Bosutinib: Nizatidine decreases the plasma concentration and efficacy of bosutinib by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 3. Nizatidine and Dasatinib: Nizatidine reduces the plasma concentration and efficacy of dasatinib by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 4. Nizatidine and Digoxin: Nizatidine increases the plasma concentration and effect of digoxin by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 5. Nizatidine and Erlotinib: Nizatidine decreases the plasma concentration and efficacy of erlotinib by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, erlotinib should be taken 10 hours after or at least 2 hours before nizatidine. 6. Nizatidine and Indinavir: Nizatidine reduces the plasma concentration and efficacy of indinavir by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 7. Nizatidine and Infigratinib: Nizatidine decreases the plasma concentration and efficacy of infigratinib by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, administer infigratinib 2 hours before or 10 hours after nizatidine. 8. Nizatidine and Itraconazole: Nizatidine reduces the plasma concentration and efficacy of itraconazole by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 9. Nizatidine and Ketoconazole: Nizatidine decreases the plasma concentration and efficacy of ketoconazole by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 10. Nizatidine and Levofloxacin: Nizatidine reduces the plasma concentration and efficacy of levofloxacin by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 11. Nizatidine and Lonafarnib: Nizatidine increases the plasma concentration and effect of lonafarnib by inhibiting hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the lonafarnib dose to the starting dose and monitor closely for arrhythmias or other adverse events. 12. Nizatidine and Mesalamine: Nizatidine decreases the plasma concentration and efficacy of mesalamine by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 13. Nizatidine and Neratinib: Nizatidine reduces the plasma concentration and efficacy of neratinib by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 14. Nizatidine and Pazopanib: Nizatidine decreases the plasma concentration and efficacy of pazopanib by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, consider using short-acting antacids instead of proton pump inhibitors or H2 antagonists, and separate dosing by several hours. 15. Nizatidine and Pexidartinib: Nizatidine increases the plasma concentration and effect of pexidartinib by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, administer pexidartinib 2 hours before or 10 hours after nizatidine. 16. Nizatidine and Pimozide: Nizatidine increases the plasma concentration and effect of pimozide by inhibiting hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 17. Nizatidine and Ponatinib: Nizatidine reduces the plasma concentration and efficacy of ponatinib by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 18. Nizatidine and Risedronate: Nizatidine increases the plasma concentration and effect of risedronate by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the delayed-release formulation of risedronate. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 19. Nizatidine and Rilpivirine: Nizatidine decreases the plasma concentration and efficacy of rilpivirine by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, administer nizatidine at least 12 hours before or 4 hours after rilpivirine. 20. Nizatidine and Sofosbuvir/Velpatasvir: Nizatidine reduces the plasma concentration and efficacy of velpatasvir by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both drugs. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, administer nizatidine simultaneously or 12 hours apart from sofosbuvir/velpatasvir at a dose comparable to famotidine 40 mg BID.
